data.retirementDetails: Units retired to compensate for GHG emissions by Richemont during its 2017/18 fiscal year. The compensation relates to forest preservation in support of transfrontier conservation areas (‘TFCAs’) facilitated by Peace Parks Foundation. This tranche of 57’000 carbon credits represents the first in a seven-year agreement with BioCarbon Partners, a leading African developer. By buying directly from the developer, the communities protecting these forests and Peace Parks Foundation will derive greater long-term security and financial benefits, thus enabling sustainable conservation efforts at scale.
